native_mechanisms: One crease per mark, each crease's angle set jointly by the mark and the preceding crease (sequential state-carrying chain).
Press every crease against all four wire birds' beaks at once and refold tighter until all four gauges agree, deliberately misaligning the spiral/snail markings so two different piles can't coincide.
Thin the whole folded wad at the water's edge down to one small dense coin and destroy every scrap, trimming and failed reading so nothing but the coin survives.
core_technique: xxHash64 verbatim — four 64-bit lanes over 32-byte blocks with the round (acc += m*PRIME2; rotl31; *PRIME1), rotl(1,7,12,18) lane merge plus mergeRound, length added, 8/4/1-byte tail, and the standard xor-shift/multiply avalanche finalizer; the native's four-beak agreement test is absent (the lanes never check or re-fold toward consensus) and the 'coin' is just the textbook finalizer.
